steps.title: Saying hello, and who you are
body: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ ("peace be upon you") is the everyday greeting; the reply is وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ.
To say your name: اسْمِي… ("my name is…"). To say what you do: أَنَا… ("I am…").
Read the short exchange below, then check you followed it.

fr.title: Dire bonjour, et qui vous êtes
body: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ (« que la paix soit sur vous ») est la salutation courante ; la réponse est وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ.
Pour dire votre nom : اسْمِي… (« mon nom est… »). Pour dire ce que vous faites : أَنَا… (« je suis… »).
Lisez le court échange ci-dessous, puis vérifiez votre compréhension.

steps.title: A short conversation

fr.title: Une courte conversation
fr.intro: Lisez l'échange et appuyez sur 🔊. Affichez le sens pour vérifier.

items.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ — وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ — مَا اسْمُكَ؟ — اسْمِي سَمِيرٌ، وَأَنَا مُعَلِّمٌ. وَأَنْتَ؟ — أَنَا دَانِيَال، وَأَنَا طَالِبٌ.
items.translit: as-salāmu ʿalaykum — wa-ʿalaykumu s-salāmu wa-raḥmatu llāhi — mā smuka? — ismī samīrun, wa-anā muʿallimun. wa-anta? — anā dāniyāl, wa-anā ṭālibun.
items.english: — Peace be upon you. — And upon you be peace and Allah's mercy. — What is your name? — My name is Samir, and I am a teacher. And you? — I am Daniel, and I am a student.

items.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَخِي — وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ — هَلْ أَنْتَ ذَاهِبٌ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ؟ — نَعَمْ، أَنَا ذَاهِبٌ لِلصَّلَاةِ إِنْ شَاءَ اللهُ — أَنَا قَادِمٌ مَعَكَ.
items.translit: as-salāmu ʿalaykum yā akhī — wa-ʿalaykumu s-salāmu wa-raḥmatu llāhi wa-barakātuhu — hal anta dhāhibun ilā l-masjidi? — naʿam, anā dhāhibun li-ṣ-ṣalāti in shāʾa llāhu — anā qādimun maʿaka.
items.english: — Peace be upon you, my brother. — And upon you be peace, and Allah's mercy and blessings. — Are you going to the mosque? — Yes, I am going for the prayer, God willing. — I am coming with you.

steps.title: Did you follow it?
steps.explanation: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ means "peace be upon you" — the everyday greeting.
